name: kredent
description: Issues and verifies agent identity and signed attestations (W3C did:key, Ed25519 over JCS-canonical RFC 8785), and computes auditable reputation scores. Identity is self-resolving (no registry, no network) and attestation verification is fully offline. Seeds are persisted locally at 0600 and never returned over the transport unless persist=false is requested.

KREDENT_HOME.description: Base directory for the local identity store. Defaults to the platform data dir; identities are stored with 0600 permissions.

tools.name: create_identity
tools.description: Generate an Ed25519 keypair and publish a self-resolving did:key identity. Persisted locally by default; the seed is returned only with persist=false.

tools.name: attest
tools.description: Sign a claim with the agent's key, producing a self-contained, offline-verifiable attestation.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Independently verify a Kredent attestation offline: Ed25519 signature, did:key binding, content-addressed id, expiry.

tools.name: reputation
tools.description: Compute an agent's reputation score from a ledger of events. Deterministic function of public events — recomputable and auditable by anyone.

privacy.keys: Ed25519 seeds are generated locally and stored at 0600. Only the public half ever appears in an identity document or attestation. A seed is returned over the transport ONLY when persist=false is explicitly requested.
privacy.network: None. did:key is self-resolving and attestation verification is offline by design; the server connects to nothing.
